taxonomyDescription.title: Specialty / Taxonomy Description
taxonomyDescription.description: Filter by provider specialty or taxonomy description. Examples: 'Internal Medicine', 'Cardiology', 'Dentist', 'Nurse Practitioner', 'Pharmacy'. Leave empty to search by name or location only.

state.title: State (2-letter code)
state.description: US state abbreviation to filter by. Examples: CA, NY, TX, FL. Leave empty for all states.

city.title: City
city.description: City name to filter by. Optional.

firstName.title: First Name (individual providers)
firstName.description: Filter by provider first name. Optional.

lastName.title: Last Name (individual providers)
lastName.description: Filter by provider last name. Optional.

enumerationType.title: Enumeration Type
enumerationType.description: NPI-1 for individual providers, NPI-2 for organizations/clinics. Leave empty for both.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of provider records to scrape. Default is 50. Use 200+ for bulk exports.
